role: Runs a non-saved HKWorkoutSession + HKLiveWorkoutBuilder on the Watch as a keep-alive during iPhone-recorded workouts, forwards wrist HR to the iPhone over WCSession as watchHRSample, and ends the session on wrist Stop when the phone is unreachable or after 30 min of iPhone silence.
types: WatchWorkoutManager: class (NSObject, ObservableObject; MainActor by target default SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION=MainActor) — Watch keep-alive workout session owner
extension WatchWorkoutManager: HKWorkoutSessionDelegate — releases sessions the system ended/failed
extension WatchWorkoutManager: HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate — forwards most recent HR
toplevel: Instance created by WatchApp @StateObject (EmuquWatch Watch App/WatchApp.swift:12). Stored-property initializers only; lastPhoneContact starts at Date().

flags.text: No test in EmuquTests/EmuquUITests references WatchWorkoutManager (start/stop idempotence, pending-auth start, phone-silence end/restart, sport mapping are untested; only WatchMessageDecoding helpers are).

flags.text: On the pending-start path the authorization-failed message written here is immediately overwritten: finishPendingStart still calls startWorkoutSession, which sets lastStartError=nil on success or replaces it with the generic 'Wrist HR fallback not started' message.
docs/USERS_MANUAL.md says the Watch app prompts for HealthKit 'the first time you tap Start'; WatchApp.wireUp requests it on the first onAppear of the root view, before any Start.

true: startWorkoutSession now and return; false: set startPending, store sport and await authorization Task

true: startWorkoutSession(pendingSportRaw); false: nothing

units.does: Creates HKWorkoutSession + associated HKLiveWorkoutBuilder with HKLiveWorkoutDataSource, sets delegates, stores both, startActivity(now), beginCollection(now) ignoring its result, and starts the phone-silence watch.

flags.text: beginCollection's completion ignores success and error (`{ _, _ in }`), so a collection failure leaves the session running without HR samples and no lastStartError.

units.does: Sets lastStartError to a localized 'Wrist HR fallback not started: <error>…' message on MainActor.

Idempotent stop: clears startPending and endedForPhoneSilence, cancels the silence task; if a session exists, nils session/builder, stopActivity(now) and endCollection, ending the session in the completion without saving a workout.

branches.effect: false: return after clearing flags (second stop is a no-op); true: tear down and end

units.does: Wrist Stop: ends the Watch session immediately only when the iPhone is not reachable (WatchMessageDecoding.endsSessionOnWristStop).

branches.effect: false: return (phone's stop reply will end it); true: stop()

branches.effect: false: return (already following); true: subscribe
notePhoneContact per message until the stream ends

units.does: Stamps lastPhoneContact=now; if the session had been ended for phone silence, clears that flag and restarts it with the previous sport when the iPhone is still recording.

branches.effect: false: return after stamping contact; true: clear flag and continue
true: start(sportRaw: sessionSportRaw); false: no restart

flags.text: The silence restart calls start() without checking displayOnlyMode, while WatchSessionManager.startWorkoutIfAllowed documents that display-only mode must NOT start an HKWorkoutSession on the Watch (Apple Health 'Record a workout' offer). The keep-alive path driveKeepAliveSession likewise starts in both modes, so the rule is only enforced on the startWorkout command.

units.does: Cancels any previous silence task, resets lastPhoneContact to now and starts a Task running checkForPhoneSilence.
Loop: sleep phoneSilenceCheckInterval (60 s) then endIfPhoneSilent until it returns true; a CancellationError from sleep ends the loop.

branches.effect: loops every 60 s while the session runs and the phone is not silent; exits when it ended or there is no session
return silently — stop() or a restart cancelled the watch

units.does: Returns true when there is no session; otherwise if the last phone contact is more than 30 min ago (phoneSilenceExceeded) calls stop(), sets endedForPhoneSilence and returns true; else false.

branches.effect: false: return true (nothing to watch); true: continue
false: return false (keep watching); true: stop(), endedForPhoneSilence=true, return true

units.does: Sends {type: watchHRSample, heartRate: bpm} via WCSession.sendMessage when reachable; no error handler.

branches.effect: false: return, sample dropped; true: send

flags.text: sendMessage is called with no errorHandler, so failed HR fallback sends vanish without a log; and there is no activationState check, unlike WatchStrapConnector.forwardSampleToiPhone.

units.does: HKWorkoutSessionDelegate state change: when the session reaches .ended or .stopped, forgets it on MainActor.

branches.effect: false: return; true: forget(workoutSession)

units.does: HKWorkoutSessionDelegate failure: forgets the session on MainActor; error itself not surfaced.
If the given session is the current one, nils session and builder so later start() calls are not blocked.

branches.effect: false: return (already torn down by stop()); true: release references

flags.text: When watchOS ends or fails the session mid-workout (e.g. another workout app takes over), the references are released but nothing restarts it: start() is only called on a recording transition or startWorkout command (WatchSessionManager.swift:749, :797), and endedForPhoneSilence is not set, so the keep-alive and wrist-HR fallback stay off for the rest of that workout. The didFailWithError error is also not shown in lastStartError.
